criteria.orientation: mean ON-window upwind alignment gain >= 0.2 and positive gain in >= 6/8 paired seeds
criteria.sourceApproach: >= 20% reduction in mean closest source distance and improvement in >= 6/8 paired seeds
criteria.temporal: ON peak exceeds sustained response; OFF rises after loss; max error against 1 ms independent RK4 < 0.002

limitations: seeded engineering assays, not registered R.A.I.N. experiments
walking constrained by model config; no spontaneous flight or walking stops
single scalar odor; synthetic stationary Gaussian footprint, no fluid or turbulent plume solver
source distance is an experimenter metric; no food reward in these assays
no learned parameters in the new filters; sensory adaptation is not associative learning
published time constants but model odor units, motor gains, geometry and protocol
body is the existing reduced-order model; MuJoCo locomotion remains unvalidated

interpretation.biologicalValidation: not established; behavioral filter implementation and synthetic engineering assay only
interpretation.newLearning: not claimed: filters adapt to recent input; existing associative and predictive learning are retained

scope: research only; original individual untouched; no live migration or deployment
